# Success

## Definition of done

- Package functions and lesson checks pass in continuous integration.
- Three complete lessons render from documented, locked environments.
- Every example supports keyboard operation and a semantic data alternative.
- Authoring, accessibility, contribution, validation, and maintenance documentation is public.
- A tagged release and final project report are archived and linked from the repository.

## Measuring success

- At least two instructors or maintainers document a concrete review or reuse outcome.
- At least one structured pilot is completed and summarized without exposing private learner data.
- At least 80% of novice pilot participants complete the Predict, Run R, Explore, and Explain loop without facilitator intervention. This small-sample target will be reported with counts and limitations.
- All critical accessibility defects found during the pilot are fixed or explicitly documented before release.
- At least one contributor outside the core team completes an issue, lesson adaptation, or documentation improvement.

## Future work

Future contributors could add domain-specific lesson packs, localization, optional WebXR adapters, additional visualization types, and integrations with established R visualization packages. These extensions remain outside the funded minimum viable product so that the project can deliver a stable and reusable foundation within six months.
